fix(camellia): omit empty classification paper type

Summary:
- stop sending `paper_type: ""` in classification modify requests
- keep sending `paper_type` when the form has a selected value

Rationale:
- the backend expects the field to be omitted when no paper type is chosen
- this keeps the existing selected-value behavior unchanged with a minimal edit

Tests:
- pnpm --dir labelix/theaceae run typecheck:camellia
- pnpm --dir labelix/theaceae run build:camellia
